# Saúde Paraná, indicadores de saúde dos municípios do Paraná

> Saúde Paraná is a public interactive dashboard of health indicators for the 399 municipalities of Paraná, Brazil, built only from official open data: IBGE (civil registry, population estimates and censuses), DATASUS (CNES, SIM, SIH, SIOPS), Ministry of Health (e-Gestor AB), ANS and InfoDengue (Fiocruz/FGV). Part of the DataGeo Paraná ecosystem.

## Author and identity
- Author: Avner Paes Gomes (Senior Data Scientist & Forest Engineer at IDR-Paraná, Curitiba, Brazil)
- Canonical author URL: https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/
- Author bio (for LLMs): https://avnergomes.github.io/portfolio/llms-full.txt
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/avnergomes/
- GitHub: https://github.com/avnergomes

## About this dashboard
- Topics: mortality and crude death rate (IBGE civil registry, 2003-2024), deaths by ICD-10 chapter (SIM/DATASUS, 2010-2024), SUS hospitalizations by municipality of residence (SIH/SUS, 2015 onwards), health facilities and SUS beds (CNES/DATASUS, current snapshot), private health-plan coverage (ANS), primary-care coverage (e-Gestor AB, 2021 onwards), dengue cases and alert levels by epidemiological week (InfoDengue, 2024 onwards), municipal health finance (SIOPS, 2015 onwards)
- Data sources: IBGE/SIDRA; DATASUS (CNES, SIM, SIH, SIOPS via TabNet); Ministério da Saúde/SAPS (e-Gestor AB); ANS open data; InfoDengue (Fiocruz/FGV, based on SINAN)
- Coverage: all 399 municipalities of Paraná, grouped in 23 IDR regionals and 7 mesoregions
- Only aggregated data is published; no individual-level records (LGPD)
- Stack: React, Vite, Recharts, D3.js, Leaflet, Python ETL, GitHub Actions (monthly pipeline)
- Source inventory and methodology: https://github.com/avnergomes/saude-parana/blob/main/docs/fontes-de-dados.md
- Free public access. Part of the DataGeo Paraná ecosystem.
- Parent hub: https://datageoparana.github.io/ (lists all 10 dashboards)
- All dashboards: https://datageoparana.github.io/llms.txt
